title: Token pruning and merge plan for button and dataviz consistency
creator: Amina Patel
description:
Goal: Reduce token surface area and create a minimal, predictable set of color/typography/spacing/radius/shadow tokens that keep Button, Table, and Chart components visually consistent across density and theme modes.

Background: Over multiple iterations the token set has grown organically: multiple near-duplicate color swatches, three competing radius scales, and divergent elevation metaphors used between UI components and dataviz layers. This causes visual drift between product surfaces and high cognitive cost for engineers and designers.

Scope: Audit current tokens used by Button, Table, Chart/Dataviz components and produce a pruning + merge plan with migration steps, automated codemods, and docs. Deliverables:
- Token audit spreadsheet with usage counts and cross-references to components.
- Proposed canonical token map (color anchors, type scale map, spacing tiers, unified radius ramp, shadow presets with semantic names).
- Migration plan with phased rollout (canary on internal product, design-review checklist, automated tests).
- Codemods and lint rules to detect deprecated tokens.
- Updated component examples and visual regression baselines.

Principles:
1) Semantic first: tokens named by role (surface-bg, interactive-primary, data-accent-1), not by hex or visual intensity.
2) Minimal levers: prefer fewer, well-documented radius/spacing steps that scale for dense and spacious layouts.
3) Backwards-safe: ensure fallback mappings to old tokens to avoid breaking customer themes during rollout.
4) Accessibility-conscious: color changes must meet contrast thresholds; we will include alternate tones for high-contrast mode.

Initial decisions:
- Merge three button radius tokens (btn-radius-xs, btn-radius-sm, btn-radius-md) into a single component token button-radius with density variants (compact, default).
- Rebase chart color accents to a 7-step perceptual ramp (data-accent-0..6) and map legacy swatches to the closest anchor with a fallback registry.
- Replace shadow token matrix with three semantic elevation presets (elevation-1, elevation-2, elevation-3) described in both pixel/light direction and CSS variable form.

Risks and trade-offs:
- Some product pages currently depend on subtle token differences for brand identity; we will run a brand-impact audit and negotiate exceptions.
- Reduced token variety may require component-level overrides for rare edge cases; these will be restricted and documented.

Migration plan (phases):
Phase 0: Audit (complete) - gather usage data and surface examples.
Phase 1: Proposal (this ticket) - finalize canonical map and get cross-team signoff.
Phase 2: Codemods & lint (2 sprints) - implement automated replacements and deprecation rule for old tokens.
Phase 3: Canary rollout (1 sprint) - land changes behind feature flag for internal dashboards and core app.
Phase 4: Public rollout & docs (1 sprint) - update tokens docs, examples, and migration guide.
Phase 5: Cleanup (post-rollout) - remove deprecated tokens and enforce lint.
